priorityList: Use Quell to interrupt enemy spellcasting.
Cast Dragonrage on cooldown as your primary burst window.
Use combat potions and Power Infusion while Dragonrage is active.
Use Tip the Scales during Dragonrage to instantly cast an empowered spell.
Use Deep Breath if you have the Imminent Destruction talent, especially to trigger Strafing Run buffs.
Cast Pyre if there are 4 or more targets, or 3 targets if you have the Feed the Flames or Volatility talents.
Cast Disintegrate (Mass Disintegrate) as your primary Essence spender to trigger Bombardments.
Cast Azure Sweep to generate Essence and maintain buffs in AoE situations.
Cast Living Flame when Leaping Flames is active and you have a Burnout or Ancient Flame proc.
Cast Azure Strike as a filler to generate Essence if other priorities are unavailable.
Use Hover to maintain damage output while moving.
Use on-use trinkets during Dragonrage, ideally once you have reached 4 stacks of Rising Fury.
Cast Emerald Blossom or Verdant Embrace to trigger Scarlet Adaptation and Ancient Flame if movement allows and Dragonrage is down.
